name: Responsive Layout: Verify Elements at Multiple Viewports
task: Write a test that verifies the hamburger menu is visible at mobile viewport sizes (390x844) and hidden at desktop sizes (1440x900) on https://www.saucedemo.com. Use setViewportSize and verify visibility expectations change with viewport. Use standard_user / secret_sauce.
passCriteria: Verifies hamburger menu is visible at mobile size
Verifies hamburger menu is hidden/not visible at desktop size
Login is performed before checking viewport-based visibility
No hard-coded waits for viewport changes
failCriteria: Doesn't actually verify visibility difference between viewports
Uses waitForTimeout to wait for resize
Assumes elements are visible without actually checking
